# Task (image generation only — do not edit any other files)

Use your image generation tool. Attach BOTH reference images to every generation: `ref_front.png` (3/4 front view, the creature faces lower-left) and `ref_back.png` (back view). They are small pixel sprites enlarged 8x. Save the results exactly as:

1. `out/keys_2x2.png` — prompt A below
2. `out/sw_single.png` — prompt B below

Do not write or modify any other file. When both PNGs are saved, reply with their paths and the image sizes.

## Prompt A (2x2 key views)

Create a high-resolution 2x2 grid (1376x768) of authentic 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art monster sprites on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF). Turn the creature from the two attached reference images (front view and back view) into crisp pixel-art sprites, keeping its exact design, proportions and colours.

CRITICAL ANATOMICAL & DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS (MUST FOLLOW 100%):
1. Body: a legless carnivorous pitcher-plant creature. NO legs, NO feet, NO arms, NO hands. The lower two thirds is ONE huge round pear-shaped / gourd-shaped yellow pitcher that sits directly on the ground with a flat round bottom; it narrows upward into a short neck.
2. Neck: the neck is tightly wrapped with several coils of a brown vine (#7B4026 with highlight #BA6F3B and dark #412214).
3. Head: ONE small yellow head on top of the neck, like the open mouth of a bell, with a small dark eye and one tiny pale fang; above it ONE pink dome-shaped lid (#EB8B79 with light pink #FEB2B6 and dark rose #94364E).
4. Crown: on top of the lid, ONE big crown of exactly 4 large round green leaves (#AFE621, #7FBB39, shadow #507715, each with a dark green midrib) spread like an umbrella; the outer edges of the leaves burn into jagged orange flame spikes (#FCA41F, #F0F016 inner glow, dark rim #B93C06). On the back view the leaves meet at ONE brown star-shaped stem knot in the centre.
5. Vines (2-Vine Rule): exactly TWO long thin brown vines (#7B4026) grow from the coiled neck: one curls down the left side of the pitcher and ends in ONE small green leaf; the other arches out to the right side and down. Never more than two vines.
6. Side leaves (2-Leaf Rule): exactly TWO small green leaves with orange flame tips grow from the upper sides of the pitcher, one on the left and one on the right, like small wings.
7. Pitcher colours: lemon yellow (#FEF35E) with mid yellow (#D8C121), golden (#F6CA1B) and olive shadow (#7B6C04); a few scattered small green leaf-shaped spots (#7FBB39, #507715) on its surface.
8. Outlines: crisp 1-2px black pixel-art outline (#000000), no anti-aliasing halo. Do not add any limbs, extra leaves, extra vines or extra heads.

GRID LAYOUT (4 key poses, large and crisp, same size, the pitcher bottom on the same baseline):
- Top-Left: SOUTH (0°, front view) — facing straight toward the viewer, symmetric: the pitcher in front, the neck coils, the head with the pink lid facing us, the leaf crown spread wide left and right, one side leaf on each side, one vine on each side.
- Top-Right: WEST (270°, left side profile) — facing LEFT in a sharp side profile: the head and its open mouth point to the left, the leaf crown seen from the side (wide and flat, tilted slightly forward), the round pitcher below, one side leaf in front, one vine hanging behind.
- Bottom-Left: NORTH-EAST (135°, back-right 3/4 view) — seen from behind and to the right: the back of the pitcher, the neck coils, the back of the leaf crown with the brown star knot, the head turned away to the upper right.
- Bottom-Right: NORTH (180°, pure back view) — seen straight from behind, symmetric like the back reference: the back of the pitcher, the vine coils, the leaf crown with the brown star knot in the middle, both side leaves.

## Prompt B (south-west single)

Create a single ultra-crisp 16-bit GBA/DS pixel-art sprite (1376x768) on a pure solid white background (#FFFFFF) of the same creature, matching the attached front reference image exactly in design, colours and pose: a legless plant creature made of one huge round yellow pear-shaped pitcher with small green spots sitting on the ground, a neck wrapped in brown vine coils, a small yellow head with a pink dome lid, a big umbrella crown of 4 round green leaves with jagged orange flame edges, exactly two small flame-tipped side leaves on the pitcher and exactly two long thin brown vines (one ending in a small green leaf). No legs, no arms.
View: SOUTH-WEST 3/4 quarter view, halfway between facing the viewer and facing left: the head and lid look diagonally down-left, the crown spreads wide. Crisp 1-2px black outline, limited palette, no anti-aliasing.
